findings.title: Mobile page scrolls sideways
findings.evidence: At 390px the document is 16px too wide; offenders: html.js.ready > body > div.progress > i (right 406px), section#hero > div.hero-scene > div.layer.far (right 406px), section#hero > div.hero-scene > div.layer.far > svg (right 406px), div.hero-scene > div.layer.far > svg > path (right 1032px).
findings.fix: Make grids collapse (minmax(0,1fr)), let long words wrap (overflow-wrap:anywhere for headings), clamp display type with clamp(), and set overflow-x: clip on sections with off-canvas decoration.

findings.title: Desktop page scrolls horizontally
findings.evidence: Document is 20px wider than the viewport: section#hero > div.hero-scene > div.layer.far, section#hero > div.hero-scene > div.layer.far > svg, div.hero-scene > div.layer.far > svg > path.
findings.fix: Contain decorative/offscreen elements with overflow: clip on their section, and avoid 100vw widths alongside a scrollbar.

findings.title: Entrance sequence is long
findings.fix: Keep the hero sequence ≲1.6 s from first paint to settled; shorten delays rather than durations. Visitors should be able to read the headline within ~600 ms.

findings.title: Layout properties are animated
findings.evidence: 72 animations/transitions on height, marginLeft, margin-left, marginTop, margin-top; 0 inline-style layout writes.
findings.fix: Animate transform and opacity (and clip-path for reveals) instead of width/height/top/left/margin; they run on the compositor and avoid reflow jank. For accordions use grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr or measure once and animate a scale/clip.

findings.title: Many elements loop forever
findings.fix: Limit ambient loops to one or two focal elements (a hero visual, a marquee). Constant motion everywhere competes with content and drains battery; pause off-screen loops.

findings.title: Tap targets are small on mobile
findings.evidence: div#hsTrack > div.hs-outro > a.link-arrow 229×30, footer.foot > div.wrap.foot-row > span.foot-links > a 69×20, footer.foot > div.wrap.foot-row > span.foot-links > a 57×20, footer.foot > div.wrap.foot-row > span.foot-links > a 51×20
findings.fix: Give touch controls at least 44×44px of hit area (padding or a pseudo-element hit box).

notes: External origins requested: https://fonts.googleapis.com, https://fonts.gstatic.com (passive font/style/script/image GETs allowed; anything else blocked)
